purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Equipment Delink details.
features: Equipment Delink Function allows the user to update PR from EQC and remove Link with EQC move.
PR Container should be linked through EQC.

events.description: Removes the link between the PR container and the EQC move. Message: "Selected PR delinked successfully"
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Equipment Delink from the single function menu
